decision.next_action: Do not download either geometry corpus. Resume a record only if the publisher releases a machine-usable exposed-surface mask and numeric independent per-axis control evidence bound to the released geometry.

dataset.title: HovoPhoto40 - high-resolution multi-epoch photogrammetry for Mt. Hochvogel

available_evidence.geometry: Five epochs each provide 40 original images, undistorted images, camera parameters, measured object points, and dense LAS/PLY point clouds.
available_evidence.native_support: The publisher reports approximately 2 mm image GSD at a 10 m object distance, well inside B1 sampling needs.
available_evidence.control: Hybrid tachymetric and GNSS control/reference points are provided; the publisher assumes approximately 4 mm accuracy per coordinate.
available_evidence.surface_description: The record identifies an alpine limestone rock slope and summit crevice as the scene.

blocking_reasons: The release contains no per-point or per-pixel rock-surface mask and no explicit mask for snow, vegetation, people, occlusion, or reconstruction artifacts.
The stated 4 mm value is an assumed control/reference coordinate accuracy, not published independent horizontal and vertical checkpoint residuals for each released dense cloud.
A steep, deforming high-alpine limestone wall is not an established analogue for Estonia exposed carbonate pavement or Devonian sandstone; it cannot gain target status by visual subject name alone.
candidates.resume_condition: Publisher-supplied surface masks plus held-out per-axis checkpoint residuals for an exact epoch, followed by a separate physical-analogue decision.

available_evidence.geometry: Phase 1 exposes reconstructable DJI P4/P1 images and raw DJI L1, Routescene, and Riegl MiniVUX survey data over a 350 by 250 m quarry.
available_evidence.native_support: Published photogrammetric GSD is approximately 7 mm for DJI P1 and 20 mm for DJI P4 RTK, well inside B1 sampling needs.
available_evidence.surface_description: The paper defines five evaluation areas spanning road, bare rock, low grass, flat ground, and inclined slopes.

blocking_reasons: The site is mainly coarse grass with shrubs and small trees plus an asphalt road; a paper figure labels a bare-rock evaluation area, but the publisher manifest and exact Phase 1 archive directory release no machine-usable area or visible-surface mask.
Raw reconstruction support and excellent independent control cannot disambiguate rock from vegetation, road, targets, stakes, and other site contents without that mask.

The exposed surface is a disused, formerly quarried limestone site. Even a later masked subset would require a separate analogue decision before it could represent natural Estonian carbonate pavement.
candidates.resume_condition: A publisher-bound vector/raster mask for the bare-rock evaluation area and its exclusion classes, or an independently licensed authoritative mask co-registered to the exact raw survey.

verification.eurosdr_phase1_archive_directory_method: Fetched the 32-byte 7z start header, 40-byte terminal header, and 22,274-byte compressed directory stream by HTTP range; reconstructed a sparse local archive and listed its directory without fetching packed survey payloads.
